designer-initial.summary: Selected and audited a six-usage ore-hold mining guard with 11 typed interactions, 11 total cases, five scenario families, one principal decision owner, and fresh-resume recovery.
questions_for_model: Can PART-01 request-edge state and PART-04 guard-mode state be expressed in separate owner-local initialization and compute contracts without PART-04 recomputing freshness?

Can CASE-01 through CASE-11 be encoded with explicit higher-priority exclusions so the resolution constrains next mode and same-evaluation outputs, including ContinueMining exactly when nextMode is Mining?

Can one root realize exactly six semantic usages and eleven end-to-end interaction meanings at semantic depth 1..2 while any required SysML-AADL containment or delegation remains behavior-free, traced, and uncredited?

diversity.closest_baseline: replicate-1 Small Station Cargo-Transfer Verification Supervisor
diversity.why_not_extension_or_rename: The selected system controls logical mining continuation from pilot, qualitative hold, and mining-support inputs; it owns mining/guard/recovery state and reports only a nearly-full advisory. It has no offload admission, transfer phase, ship/warehouse evidence reconciliation, transfer command, or completion finding, so the replicate-1 cargo-transfer transaction is outside rather than repartitioned inside its boundary.

model-review.summary: The selected 6/11/11/5 allocation is realizable unchanged and every claimed owner derives a nonidentity local fact.

findings.evidence: Extensionally, PART-01 derives temporal freshness, conflict, and priority; PART-02 maps four hold/status pairs to three facts with a two-element invalid fiber; PART-03 maps sixteen support samples to three classes; PART-04 owns the stateful eleven-case composition; PART-05 maps five modes many-to-one to two commands; and PART-06 maps the compound resolution many-to-one to status and readiness. None is a copier, bundle-only owner, rerouter, or one-to-one enum/code rename.

SysML-AADL library commit 9016cbcceefa92f0068e1811923704dd261d15f1 and the trusted Isolette forms support System/Process/Thread containment, typed DataPort/PortConnection flows, Thread-local GUMBO state, initialize, compute cases, and prior-state references; current accepted checker evidence supports attribute-based Data records and In(state).

One explicit root System usage, one uncredited behavior-free Process, six semantic Threads, twelve raw hops realizing the six boundary interactions, and five direct inter-Thread connections realize exactly eleven semantic interactions at physical depth two with seventeen raw PortConnection declarations and one weakly connected semantic region.

Independent enumeration of exactly 40,960 snapshots produced CASE-01 through CASE-11 witness counts 35840, 2560, 1280, 1120, 6, 26, 32, 32, 32, 8, and 24, with zero partition gaps and zero mining-command or offload-readiness equivalence mismatches. The recovery protocol has a finite low-then-high witness after same-evaluation resume discard.

Owner-local contracts can keep three request-history values solely in PART-01 and guardMode solely in PART-04 while PART-04 consumes RequestAssessment, HoldAssessment, and SupportAssessment and downstream owners consume GuardResolution. Attribute members make every planned compound-field access local and checker-resolvable without raw-input recomputation or mirror state.

designer-resolution.summary: Model findings accepted with unchanged 6/11/11/5 baseline; generation is authorized under exact owner-local, support, analysis, and claim-boundary constraints.

model-generation.summary: Relabeled the two downstream ownership-audit wire roles as proposal without changing source semantics; the focused protocol check, SysML typecheck, and 40,960-snapshot bounded analyzer all passed.

visualization.summary: Accepted one validated system overview with zero connector crossings and route-object collisions; native and complete traceability reviews passed.

designer-final.summary: Source, bounded semantics, ownership, traceability, and rendered visualization passed without silent drift; execution was not run by profile.
